name: real-japan
description: Dry run of the live Japan trip (2026-11-02): place names as slugs, couples S (sleeps in Yokohama days 1-3, the only couple in Japan then) and A. There is no Yokohama place in the library (the four 'yokohama' units are Hakone / Fuji day trips), so days 1-3 can only hold Tokyo places: the Yokohama stay has no hotel booking, so its point is the city centre, and Tokyo is within NEAR_KM (30 km) of it. Those Tokyo places are allowed there (nothing of Yokohama's is eligible) but must be reported as away (in Tokyo); the Hakone day trip on day 2 is not.
